name: io.github.verax-ai/verax
title: VERAX
description: The body an agent asks before it acts: decide, approve, and keep a signed record on your machine.

environmentVariables.name: VERAX_ISSUER
environmentVariables.description: Issuer the agent's token must carry. The body refuses to start without one; `verax doctor` names what is missing.

environmentVariables.name: VERAX_JWKS_URL
environmentVariables.description: Where the body fetches the keys that verify that token.

environmentVariables.name: VERAX_AUDIENCE
environmentVariables.description: Audience the token must name, so a token minted for something else is refused.

environmentVariables.name: VERAX_STATE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory the ledger, keys and approvals live in. It stays on this machine.
